title: Simulation and analysis for engineering and research teams
lede: I build physical models that hold up to scrutiny: high-fidelity simulations, thermal and structural design studies, and statistical analysis of difficult data. The same standards I apply in theoretical physics, applied to your problem.

services.title: High-fidelity simulation
services.text: Multiphysics and CFD models built from the governing equations up, with mesh and time-step convergence studies, checks against analytic limits and validation against measurements. You receive the model itself, ready to rerun and extend.
services.tools: ANSYS, COMSOL Multiphysics, Python and C solvers
proof: Airfoil noise study validated in a wind tunnel
services.short: Multiphysics and CFD models with convergence studies and validation against measurements.

services.title: Thermal and flow engineering
services.text: Heat transfer, cooling architectures, reacting flows and emissions. I set up conjugate heat-transfer and flow models to compare design options and find the margins that matter before hardware is built.
proof: Liquid and phase-change cooling for high-power cells
services.short: Heat transfer, cooling design, reacting flows and emissions.

services.title: Structural analysis and design optimisation
services.text: Finite-element stress and fatigue analysis, and topology optimisation to remove mass without giving up stiffness or service life. Geometry is delivered back in CAD, ready for the next iteration.
proof: Lower-limb orthotics at the Dassault Systèmes Product Innovation Lab
Servicing architectures and transfer budgets for on-orbit repair
services.short: Stress and fatigue analysis, and topology optimisation for lighter parts.

services.title: Data analysis and inference
services.text: Bayesian parameter estimation, MCMC with proper convergence diagnostics, model comparison and uncertainty quantification for noisy or correlated data. Every result comes with its error budget and the code that produced it.
proof: Supernova cosmology with full covariance at NAOJ and ENEA–Sapienza
services.short: Bayesian estimation, MCMC and uncertainty quantification for difficult data.

process.title: Define the question
process.text: A call to pin down what has to be decided, what data and drawings exist, and what a useful answer looks like.

process.title: Agree the scope
process.text: A short written scope with deliverables, assumptions and a timeline, before any modelling starts.

process.title: Model and check
process.text: Work in stages with interim results, so assumptions are visible and can be challenged early.

process.title: Hand over
process.text: A technical report, the models or code, and a walkthrough so your team can reuse and extend the work.
